channel.title: Nolan Kido | Practical AI writing
channel.description: Essays and recorded cases about practical AI, checking results, and human judgment. Tools and website edits are not new articles.

item.title: Let AI do more. Keep the judgment.
item.description: Delegating production is not the same as handing over responsibility. An essay on purpose, boundaries, permission, and the choices worth keeping human.

item.title: Checking an AI-assisted website change.
item.description: A documented AI-assisted website change passed 347 tests but still had malformed HTML. Inspect the repair, reproduce the failure, and reuse the checking method.

item.title: A working tool is not the same as a trustworthy one.
item.description: Two calculations agree. Both are wrong. A small worked example of the difference between a convincing demonstration and independent evidence.
